description: Find public PTE Academic sample questions by question type, skill category, difficulty, prediction status or keyword. Returns one representative sample per question type with its prompt, audio or image, tags, difficulty and frequency. Answer keys and explanations are not included.

difficulty.description: Filter by the difficulty label of the public sample.

limit.description: Maximum samples to return. Defaults to 10, capped at 20.

predictionOnly.description: When true, only include samples marked as prediction questions.

query.description: Keyword to match against the question type name, tags or prompt text.

questionType.description: PTE question type code, for example RA, RS, DI, WE, FIBDD or WFD. Omit to search every type.

name: search_questions
title: Search public PTE sample questions
